caseStudy.title: MeridianIndex
caseStudy.background:
MeridianIndex ingests records from a dataset with 120 tenants and builds versions of a knowledge index. An AKS node pool hosts CPU-only APIs; it scales rapidly during peaks. The container registry uses a controlled service identity and digest-based promotion. The canary started failing health checks after the application added a multi-minute local model prewarm.

Both the API and a Python Function use an Entra identity. The new App Configuration release updates the vector model and retrieval thresholds together. App Configuration refresh is driven by a sentinel. Two vector models have equal vector dimensions, but model-space compatibility is explicitly not guaranteed.

Some Service Bus updates represent permanent schema errors. The audit team must receive a reason and inspect the original payload without retrying poison messages indefinitely.

exhibits.title: YAML probe excerpt
exhibits.code:
livenessProbe:
  httpGet: {path: /health/live, port: 8080}
  periodSeconds: 10
  failureThreshold: 3
# model startup can take 140 seconds

exhibits.title: Release metadata
exhibits.code:
retrieval:model: candidate-v4
retrieval:maxDistance: 0.22
retrieval:generation: 41
sentinel: pending

options: Use only smaller vectors from the old model regardless of query encoder
Skip backfill because column dimensions are equal
Backfill and validate a versioned index, then switch the query encoder and index together
Mix the embeddings and rely on metadata after retrieval

questions.answer: summarize Tail = percentile(DurationMs, 91) by ResultCode
questions.explanation: percentile aggregates a requested quantile over each group. Multiplying individual durations does not calculate a percentile.
options: extend Tail = DurationMs * 0.91
summarize Tail = avg(DurationMs) by ResultCode
summarize Tail = percentile(DurationMs, 91) by ResultCode
summarize Tail = max(DurationMs) by ResultCode

questions.prompt: Type the Redis SET option used in the trident command to express a 165-second expiry.
answer: EX
questions.explanation: SET with EX attaches an expiration in seconds as part of the value write.

exhibits.code: SET trident:summary result ____ 165

questions.prompt: The trident app must pick up current secret versions on future fetches. Which Key Vault call avoids pinning a specific version?
questions.answer: client.get_secret("trident-db-password")

client.list_properties_of_secrets()
client.get_secret("trident-db-password", version="old-version")

questions.prompt: The trident sender retried within the broker duplicate detection window. Which message property must stay unchanged on an unpartitioned queue?
questions.answer: message_id

options: message_id
delivery_count
locked_until_utc
sequence_number
